notes: Building Center Amana page is history-only (https://www.building-center.org/amana-hvac-age/, no serial system), so these styles come from Amana-specific independent sources, NOT inherited from Goodman (usesStylesOf is null; the Goodman file is not cited as source): PickHVAC Amana page (primary), corroborated by GGR Home Inspections Amana guide and HowToLookAtAHouse Amana posts (first two digits = year) and an InterNACHI thread (9108033656 = August 1991, year-first/second-two-month). CONFLICT FLAGGED: QualityHomeAirCare states the opposite order (MMYY, example 0215 = February 2015) for Goodman & Amana; that source is the outlier against PickHVAC, GGR, HowToLookAtAHouse, InterNACHI, and the Building Center Goodman rule (YYMM), and its example contains a letter, inconsistent with all-numeric Amana serials, so YYMM is used. AUTHORITY NOTE: PickHVAC is a third-party decoder site, not manufacturer documentation; Fred approved keeping this file on Oct 28, 2026 on the strength of the 4-to-1 corroboration (PickHVAC + GGR + HowToLookAtAHouse + InterNACHI against the MMYY outlier). yearFloor 2001 on styles 1-2 reflects the sources' stated 2001-present era.

styles.notes: PickHVAC Style 1 example 0211847363 = November 2002; plate example 1612117501 = December 2016 (shown on the Amana page as a Goodman plate illustrating the same system).
PickHVAC Style 2 example 080359478 = March 2008. Source states the 9- vs 10-character difference is unclear; first four digits carry the date in both.

PickHVAC Style 3 example 98-90558 = 1998, month not encoded. Pattern is the normalized form: the builder strips dashes, so the documented 8-character 98-90558 becomes 7 digits; no undashed 7-digit Amana style is documented, so collision risk is noted but low.
